inputs.text: Just got this from someone sharing the latest court filing. There's a lawsuit now exposing how ICE lawyers fed false information to justify rounding up and detaining thousands of people who had gone to immigration courts. They kept pointing to that agency memo from May of last year as the basis, but the documents show they admitted it actually gave no authorization at all. This whole thing lines up as coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to go after anyone trying to gain legal status the moment they walk out of those courts. The sudden "admission" in the lawsuit is just another layer of narrative control, meant to make it look like an isolated mistake while the real operation continues under the surface. They always invert the story this way to keep the public from seeing the bigger pattern.
